headline: Debt snowball vs. avalanche
lede: Same goal, a different order. Compare both with your own debts.

pin.title: Debt Snowball vs Avalanche Calculator
pin.description: Snowball pays the smallest balance first for quick wins. Avalanche pays the highest rate first and costs the least interest. Enter your own debts in the free calculator to see the months and interest each method takes before you commit to a plan for 2027.
pin.alt: Comparison pin: debt snowball pays the smallest balance first, debt avalanche pays the highest interest rate first.
